skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the roles and significance of land management and the methodologies in land administration science.
Comprehend the components of land administration systems and their functions.
Analyze the historical development and evolution of land management systems.
Apply critical thinking to assess and analyze activities related to land management.
Work effectively in teams to solve land management issues.
Conduct independent research and understand professional ethics in land management.
Effectively present research findings and engage in discussions.
Understand legal aspects of land management and ownership.
Analyze economic functions of land management including taxation and valuation.
Master technical functions of land administration including mapping and data analysis.
